is-public.description: Whether the measurement results are publicly visible on RIPE Atlas.

last-collected.description: Date and time the results were last collected.

launch-time.description: Date and time the measurement was created.

observed-ip.description: IP address of the target as seen by the probes (dst_addr in the results). Multiple when probes resolve the name to different addresses.

probes-reached-target.description: Number of probes that reached the target (ping: at least one reply; traceroute: destination responded; dns: a response was received; sslcert: a certificate was retrieved).

probes-scheduled.description: Number of probes scheduled for the measurement.

raw-results.description: Raw RIPE Atlas results (JSON) as returned by the API, kept as evidence.

results-received.description: Number of probe results collected so far.

results-url.description: RIPE Atlas API URL of the measurement results.

rtt-max.description: Highest RTT in milliseconds across all probes (maximum of the per-probe maximums).

rtt-median.description: Median in milliseconds of the per-probe median RTTs.

rtt-min.description: Lowest RTT in milliseconds across all probes (minimum of the per-probe minimums).

status.description: Last known measurement status as reported by the RIPE Atlas API.

target.description: Measurement target: IP address or hostname, or the query argument for DNS measurements.

description: A measurement launched on RIPE Atlas (ping, traceroute, dns or sslcert) from a MISP enrichment module, used to track its status and collect its results.
name: ripe-atlas-measurement
